role: Bulk of WorkoutNamespace's catalog (extension): live route topology/weather/recognized-route facts, hrv.peak.* and hrv.window.* overnight facts, user.profile FTP facts, workout feeling/segment-compare/most-recent snapshot/deep-dive/streak facts, the workout.timeline downsampler, a fileprivate Array.nilIfEmpty, and SegmentPointSampler shared with the live segment lookback.
types: WorkoutNamespace: extension — detail FactEntry declarations and resolvers
SegmentPointSampler: enum — nearest-GPS-fix + per-second sample matcher
toplevel: Static AI-facing description strings; fileprivate Array.nilIfEmpty whose comment (lines 694-696) claims a twin in Models/WorkoutThreshold.swift that does not exist in the repo.

flags.text: Keys `workout.live.route_topology/weather/recognized_route`, `hrv.peak.*`, `hrv.window.*` and `user.profile.*_ftp` are declared in WorkoutNamespace (namespace 'workout') although WorkoutLiveNamespace, the hrv namespace and the user namespace exist; non-'workout' keys resolve only through FactResolverRegistry's fallback scan over all namespaces.

No tests reference route_topology, workout.live.weather, recognized_route, hrv.peak.*, hrv.window.*, user.profile.*_ftp, most_recent.snapshot, deep_dive, streak.*, workout.timeline or SegmentPointSampler.

units.does: Flattens the six detail entry groups (live, hrv peak, hrv window, user profile, feeling/segment/snapshot, streak) into one list.
Returns live route topology, weather and recognized-route entries.
Returns hrv.peak total power and RMSSD entries.
Returns hrv.window classification / organized / consolidated entries.
Returns user.profile running and cycling FTP entries.
Returns feeling, feeling note, segment compare, most-recent snapshot and deep-dive entries.
Returns streak consecutive-days and this-week-count entries.
Declares fixed fact `workout.live.route_topology` resolved by resolveWorkoutLiveRouteTopology.
Reads the live workout snapshot and returns its bound route topology as a record.

branches.effect: false: missing(.notYetComputed,'no route bound'); true: record

units.does: Builds topology record: climbs_ahead, turns_ahead lists, ascent remaining, peak altitude, altitude above route min, meters to peak, optional steepest grade.
Builds one climb record: distance to start, grade, plus length/gain when > 0 and road_name when non-empty.
Builds one turn record: distance, signed bearing change, direction label.
Declares fixed fact `workout.live.weather` resolved by resolveWorkoutLiveWeather.
Returns the live snapshot's weather (temp, wind speed/direction, humidity, conditions, observed_at, optional apparent temp).

branches.effect: false: missing(.notYetComputed,'weather fetch hasn't returned yet')

units.does: Declares fixed fact `workout.live.recognized_route` resolved by resolveWorkoutLiveRecognizedRoute.
Returns matched route record when the live snapshot has a recognized route name, else the diagnostic unmatched record.
Builds {status:'matched', name, auto_detected, direction?, total_distance_meters?, climbs_ahead_total?}.

Reads RouteLibrary.detectionTriggerMeters (500) and SavedRouteStore.routes.count on MainActor, classifies recognizer status and returns a diagnostic record with covered/trigger meters and detail text.

flags.text: MainActor.assumeIsolated is used from a fact resolver closure; it traps at runtime if the resolver ever runs off the main actor.

units.does: Maps (savedCount, covered, trigger) to status no_saved_routes / awaiting_distance / no_match with English detail text.

branches.effect: status awaiting_distance with remaining meters; else no_match citing 30 m tolerance (hard-coded text, matches RouteLibrary.matchToleranceMeters)

flags.text: 'saved_route_count' counts every saved route regardless of sport, while RouteLibrary.findMatch only matches supported sports; for an unsupported sport (e.g. row) the status says 'none fit current path' even though matching was never attempted.

units.does: Declares `workout.segment_compare($params)` resolved by resolveWorkoutSegmentCompareParams.
Parses 'lat,lon[,radius_m]' (radius 5..5000, default 50), finds past workouts passing within radius and returns their per-point records.

branches.effect: true: missing(.notRecorded,'no past workouts passed within Nm'); false: list

units.does: Decrypts the 30 newest workouts and returns SegmentPointSampler.match for each that passes within radius.

flags.text: Same 30-newest-workouts scan + SegmentPointSampler.match as WorkoutLiveNamespace.lookbackMatches (which additionally excludes the active session).

Comment says the scan is 'Capped at 30 most-recent GPS-bearing workouts', but prefix(30) is taken over all workout entries before any GPS check (match returns nil without gpsPolyline), so indoor/treadmill/row workouts use up the cap and fewer than 30 GPS workouts are searched.

units.does: Declares fixed fact `workout.most_recent.snapshot`: deepDiveRecord of the newest workout.

branches.effect: false: missing(.notRecorded,'no workouts recorded') — also returned when decryption fails; true: deep-dive record

flags.text: If the newest workout entry fails to decrypt, the fact returns 'no workouts recorded' (notRecorded) instead of falling back to the next entry or reporting a read error, although workoutAvailability says workouts exist.

units.does: Declares `workout.deep_dive.by_date($date)`: deepDiveRecord for the newest workout on that date.

branches.effect: false: missing(.notRecorded,'no workout recorded for X'); true: record

units.does: Declares fixed fact `workout.streak.consecutive_days` returning consecutiveWorkoutDays.
Counts consecutive local days ending today that have at least one workout entry.

branches.effect: true: streak+1 and step back a day; false: stop

units.does: Declares fixed fact `workout.streak.this_week_count`: workouts dated from the locale week start through now.
Returns [workoutTimelineByDateDateEntry].
Declares `workout.timeline.by_date($date)`: downsampled per-second timeline for the newest workout on that date.

branches.effect: false: missing(.notRecorded,'no per-second sample stream'); true: timelineRecord

units.does: Sorts samples, sets bucketSec = ceil(lastOffset/200) (min 1), groups samples by offset/bucketSec and returns envelope {date, duration_sec, bucket_sec, bucket_count, buckets, sport?}.

branches.effect: always true for existing keys; else dropped

flags.text: Bucket index is offset/bucketSec, so a sample at the final offset (== 200×bucketSec when duration divides evenly) lands in a 201st bucket; the '~200 buckets max' cap is exceeded by one.
Comment says 'a 1-hour run with 30s buckets is 120 records', but the code gives a 1-hour run 18 s buckets and 200 records.

units.does: Builds one bucket record: offset_sec plus medians of HR (rounded int), pace, cadence, altitude, alpha1, power (rounded int) and bucket grade when available.

branches.cond: power values non-empty and median exists

units.does: Grade % = (last alt - first alt)/(last dist - first dist)×100 when both ends have altitude and distance and ≥5 m covered.

branches.cond: first/last altitude and distance present and Δdistance ≥ 5

units.does: Median of a Double array (mean of middle two for even count); nil when empty.

branches.effect: average of two middle values; odd: middle value

units.does: Returns nil for an empty array, else self.

flags.text: Comment says Array.nilIfEmpty is also defined fileprivate in Models/WorkoutThreshold.swift, but grep of the repo finds no other nilIfEmpty definition; the extension is also redundant at its only use because median() already returns nil for an empty array.

units.does: Decodes a session's GPS polyline into a track, finds nearest fix to target; if within radius returns record {date, sport rawValue, offset_sec_at_point, distance_to_point_m, pace_sec_per_km_at_point?, sample fields}.
Adds HR/power/cadence/altitude/alpha1 from the sample nearest offsetSec when within ±10 s.
Full scan returning the sample whose offsetSec is closest to the target.
